description.en:
T800 is EngineAI's full-size humanoid platform for dynamic motion and general application development. Its published configuration is 173 cm tall with 29 body degrees of freedom, excluding dexterous hands. The manufacturer emphasizes high-output joints, an aluminum-alloy structure and coordinated transitions between whole-body movements.

Active cooling in the leg joints is intended to support sustained operation, while surrounding perception feeds the control system. Public demonstrations include walking and demanding athletic routines. Those demonstrations illustrate motion capabilities under their test conditions; practical manipulation, interaction and industrial performance depend on the installed hands, sensing and task software.
description.zh: 融合高动态运动、全向感知、长续航与可配置算力的全尺寸通用人形机器人，面向仓储物流、酒店服务、门店导购与工厂协作。
